fusions.name: Stripping Pass
fusions.desc: Drags a swarm-laden link across an enemy that deals 7 damage and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Swarm Reaping
fusions.desc: Looses a cloud of links in a cone ahead of you that deals 28 damage that ignores resistances to everything within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Tethered Cloud
fusions.desc: Looses a swarm tethered to you for 12 seconds. It strikes an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Devouring Reach
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a link whips to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 7 damage, then jumps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 5 seconds.
